item.title: Samurai Babel #1
item.description:
1 Introduction

The world of Babel takes on the lands of Las Angeles, lands of forbidden wars, a land of lost and confusion. Where the lies become the sins of the persons. Turned into several Shogun Tribes, Cabals. Of fear and fearless lands.
We dig into them as lost souls, keepers or saviours of them own skins.
Today, those lands are even through a piece to achieve every day, with no struggles. The wars led to us to a dark moment lost in our own minds. A dark moment for don’t be forgiven or led to us a war again.
Every Cabal has his own rules, his own code, his own conduct to achieve our own peace.

item.title: Los reyes de Bathleron
item.description:
La Reina de Bathleron

  • El Inicio

El Inicio

  • Hola, estoy perdida. Necesito ayuda. ¿Puedes ayudarme? ¿Por favor?
  • No, estoy en mis días. Necesito ayuda. Mucho. No recuerdo mucho, pero quería hacer todo bien. Estoy perdida en el tiempo.

Hoy en día todos están perdidos… El tiempo está perdido. No te sientes bien. Todo es una amenaza. Todo para todos es una amenaza. Estamos en el siglo XXI, con guerras equivocadas como la fe sin fe. No te sientes bien hoy, tampoco ayer.

item.title: Ekron Xandra
item.description:
Ekron: Xandra

  • The Call

    The Call

Hurry up! Hurry up!

The warrior is coming. The warrior is coming… The steps are being heard. The hell came to war. Who’s coming? Hell god dammit. It came. Shiva must come to gather all mankind of Gaia to the rescue. The warriors’ bleeding never stops. The hell came. No more sorrow to bleed. The needles are dying inside me. Step aside. You should must be a survivor. Strike it again over a call. The call must be against hell. Hell gates opened. Strike against the surviving feed. The bleeding is never ending. The torch came to enlighten us. The serpentine flesh is dying inside hell’s calling. No more pleasure. Never let us alone on this oblivion. The dying bride is dying. Let her bleed. I cannot wait to die. The world is engulfing the streams.

Pedro Dias Vicente

Chapter 1: The income

The end is near… Destruction above.. Over these times we are dying…

The echoes of the time are dying. I assure the moments flow. Let them dying inside my shame.

The mirrors spoke. The underline of the lies were awaken. Tears shed glass. Resurrection flow over the wounds.

We are facing tears being shed or being spoken. The war came for the resurrection. Heaven brought haven feelings. I felt comfort. All I made was shedding tears in smoking trees. We are the impulse of the treason of war. Let me in. The inner self is under control.

item.title: Ekron Dark Reign #2
item.description:
Ekron Dark Reign #2

  • The Summoner

    The Summoner

I cannot pretend. I won’t pretend. I am the living proof. The rhythm awakens the dragons, the willing proof. I am the Nation unborn. Will you kill me? Shoot at me. I am in suffer. I am not in suffer anymore. Gimme God a little more. I am on denial. Fractions suddenly lost. I am not ready to die. Will you save me? God is saving me, breathing more. I won’t woke up no more. I am the priest, I am the person who knows me better. Will you? Will you stop my bleeding? Dad, save me, I am feeling lost. Gimme a call. This urgent cull for summoning is dying. Can you hear me? I am dying. Am I dying? I need the call. I am crying. I need home to shed tears. Don’t tell me lies. I won’t tell lies. Over this manuscript, I won’t pretend. I am not a fool. I am racing against the clock. Time cannot erase the past. Now, the whispers of the present are mine. The casts of the today are not dying no more.

item.title: Ekron Dark Reign #1
item.description:
Ekron Dark Reign #1

  • The Beginning

    The Beginning

Autumn came. We are lost now. Our struggles became fear. The doors are closing. The fears became hunted. The warriors became fearless. Love became hunted. We are the shallow grave. We are the graveyards of ourselves. We are the true believers. Taking control. The limits are the boundaries. I am breaking tides. I passed over the limits. I won’t never lie. In a living form. The world have begun. We are in between us. The meltdown is breaking the tides. I am not running again. In between us the space is for ourselves. Theres’ so much more. Break the tides. We sang the songs of the sirens. Autumn came. We are lost now. Can you see my tears coming? Are you the suffering? Do you know me? I am the priest. I am the Pendragon myth. A living proof. We walk over lust. Suffering from your past. Take my words as a living proof. Before you broke the tides. Desperation. The reasons are betraying us from inside. The secrecy are dying in pieces. Do you feel your fears? Can you handle for that? I am the priest. Taking one more time. Can you feel home? I feel. I am not alone.
